fact: A source at the Ministry of Electricity said the ministry is preparing a new 500 kV substation and line in New Alamein, with investment up to EGP 3 billion, to secure power for a Heca Data data-centre project needing initially up to 5,000 MW in phases (planned, not yet in service).
title: مصدر بالكهرباء: 3 مليارات جنيه لتأمين كهرباء مركز بيانات ضخم في العلمين
